mapper.select: SELECT ha.*, a.admin_name as auditor_name, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_audit ha LEFT JOIN sys_admin a ON ha.admin_id = a.admin_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON ha.house_id = h.house_id WHERE ha.audit_id = #{id}
